code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation), mild anemia with increased red cell count and distribution width, mild thrombocytopenia, and leukopenia with relative lymphopenia and monocytosis. These findings may suggest a response to hypoxia, possible underlying infection or inflammation, and bone marrow stress. Other parameters, including renal and liver function, are within normal limits. Clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
